notes.title: Game Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve just released a fresh update to the [b]The Face Horror Game Demo[/b], and we’re excited to share what’s new:[/p][p]✨ [b]Improved Animation Fidelity[/b]
Characters now move more fluidly and expressively — making every scene feel more alive and immersive.[/p][p]🖱️ [b]Mouse Cursor Fix[/b]
We’ve fixed the mouse cursor issue! It now properly hides during gameplay for a cleaner and more immersive experience.[/p][p]⏱️ [b]Better Pacing[/b]
We've adjusted the timing and flow of key scenes to improve the overall gameplay experience — making it more engaging from start to finish.[/p][p]Thank you for all your feedback so far! This update brings us one step closer to the full vision of the game. 💀👁️[/p][p]Download the updated demo, and let us know what you think!
Your input means everything and helps us keep making the game better.[/p][p]Stay spooky,
[b]Scary Creepy Pasta[/b][/p]
